name: geofence_proof
description: Prove a private (lat, lng) lies inside a public rectangular bounding box without revealing the exact point. Coordinates use 32-bit fixed-point: lat = round((lat_deg + 90) * 1e6), lng = round((lng_deg + 180) * 1e6)
useCases: Prove presence inside a geographic bounding box without exact coordinates
Location-gated drops that never learn where the user is

latMin.description: Inclusive minimum encoded latitude of the geofence

latMax.description: Inclusive maximum encoded latitude of the geofence

lngMin.description: Inclusive minimum encoded longitude of the geofence

lngMax.description: Inclusive maximum encoded longitude of the geofence
